title: The Ego Default
coreMove: Name the self-image threat before it converts feedback into defense.
sourcePressure: Ego is the default that protects self-image, status, rank, and identity before truth or learning gets a vote. The source lane is narrow: status threat, territory, hierarchy, self-preservation, and the border with social pressure.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Making ego a personality insult instead of a repeatable judgment failure under status pressure.

sourceAnchors.name: the four-default map
sourceAnchors.detail: the official excerpt-backed bundle names ego as one of the four defaults and ties the early biology frame to territory, hierarchy, and self-preservation
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Ego turns a bruise to self-image into a problem that feels larger than the facts in front of you.
